title: Low volume
isn't empty.

slides.sub: Why price gets rejected at the thinnest part of the profile.

slides.title: What an LVN really is
slides.body: A low volume node is a price where almost nothing traded. One side was in full control and price moved through it in minutes. It separates two value areas: it is a border, not a gap waiting to be filled.

slides.title: The setup on NQ
slides.body: Value builds at 24,520-24,560. Then a fast drop through 24,480 in a few minutes, and new value forms lower at 24,420-24,440. Later price rallies back into 24,480: the thin zone between the two areas.
slides.tip: The question is not IF price returns. It's what happens there.

slides.title: Footprint at the LVN
slides.body: On the return, sellers hit the bid 3x or more the ask one tick above: 3 stacked sell imbalances at 24,479-24,481 and price can't hold above.

footprint.label: 3 stacked sells at the LVN · delta -645

slides.title: Rejection vs acceptance
slides.body: Rejection: price pokes into the LVN and leaves fast, sell imbalances print, delta stays negative. Acceptance: price spends time there, volume builds, the thin zone fills into a node and value can migrate higher.
slides.tip: Speed + imbalances = rejection. Time + volume = acceptance.

caption:
Low volume isn't empty. It's a WALL. ⚠️

A low volume node is a price where almost nothing traded: one side was in full control and price ripped through it in minutes. It is the border between two value areas, not a "gap" that is easy to cross. On NQ, price dropped through 24,480 and built new value at 24,420-24,440. When it rallied back, the footprint printed 3 stacked sell imbalances at the LVN (sellers hitting the bid 3x or more the ask one tick above), delta -645, and price could not hold above 24,480. That is rejection, not weakness.

1️⃣ Mark the LVN edges between value areas on your volume profile
2️⃣ Fast poke + stacked sell imbalances + negative delta = rejection
3️⃣ Time + volume building at the LVN = acceptance: then the rejection idea is invalid
